{{- /*
  Overrides Hextra's llms.txt for one reason: its entry line summarises each page with
  `.Summary`, which on every page in this course is the `{{% admonition abstract %}}`
  glance block. That published 74 entries that began "In one glance" and then broke the
  one-line-per-entry format with the block's own newlines, carrying `&rsquo;` and friends
  through to the consumer.

  Every page carries a curated one-sentence `description` — the same string the HTML
  `<meta name="description">` publishes — so that is what an agent fetching this index
  should read. Collapsing whitespace and the first `htmlUnescape` only matter for the
  `.Summary` fallback, which cannot fire while tools/internal/conventions requires a
  description on every page; `truncate` bounds that fallback alone, since the longest
  description in content/ is 222 characters — 7.3b. Cost Governance — and no curated
  sentence is clipped. The second `htmlUnescape` is what reaches the file: `truncate`
  re-escapes the text it emits, so without it every apostrophe ships as `&#39;`.

  Kept verbatim from upstream otherwise, so the two stay comparable on a theme bump.
*/ -}}
# {{ .Site.Title }}

> {{ .Site.Params.description | default "" }}

{{ range where site.Sections "Params.llms" "ne" false }}
{{- template "llms-section-tree" dict "context" . "level" 2 }}
{{ end }}

{{- $rootPages := where (where site.RegularPages "Section" "") "Params.llms" "ne" false }}
{{- if $rootPages }}
## Root Pages
{{- range $rootPages }}
- [{{ .Title }}]({{ .Permalink }}): {{ or .Description .Summary | plainify | htmlUnescape | replaceRE `\s+` " " | strings.TrimSpace | truncate 250 | htmlUnescape }}{{ if .Date }} - Published {{ .Date.Format "2006-01-02" }}{{ end }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}

---
Generated on {{ now.Format "2006-01-02 15:04:05 UTC" }}
Site: {{ .Site.BaseURL }}

{{- define "llms-section-tree" -}}
{{- $context := .context -}}
{{- $level := .level | default 2 -}}
{{- $headerHashes := strings.Repeat $level "#" -}}
{{- "\n" -}}
{{ $headerHashes }} {{ $context.Title }}

{{- range where $context.RegularPages "Params.llms" "ne" false }}
- [{{ .Title }}]({{ .Permalink }}): {{ or .Description .Summary | plainify | htmlUnescape | replaceRE `\s+` " " | strings.TrimSpace | truncate 250 | htmlUnescape }}{{ if .Date }} - Published {{ .Date.Format "2006-01-02" }}{{ end }}
{{- end }}

{{- range where $context.Sections "Params.llms" "ne" false }}
{{ template "llms-section-tree" dict "context" . "level" (add $level 1) }}
{{- end }}
{{- end -}}
